templates.name: Acceptance of the Company Code of Conduct

blocks.text: Acceptance of the Company Code of Conduct
I, {employee.name} of NRIC No. {employee.icNo}, hereby have read and understand the content of Major and Minor Misconduct listing as below.
a) Minor Misconduct – 1st time misconduct (becoming major if repeated)

blocks.columns: No., Misconduct, Type of disciplinary action
blocks.rows:
1 | Tardiness and absence – failure to be at workstation at proper time / reporting late for work / leaving early | 
2 | Absence from work without prior permission from Superior or without reasonable excuses | 
3 | Failure to report for pre-arranged overtime | 
4 | Excessive Sick Leave i.e. habitual sick leave taken on certain work days e.g. Fridays / Mondays / before or after Public Holidays | 
5 | Disorderly conduct i.e. interfering with the work of other employees | 
6 | Abuse of Emergency Leave / Compassionate Leave | 
7 | Posting and/or removing and/or tampering with the Company Notice Board without Authorization | 
8 | Inattention to duties – Deliberate loafing on the job such as idling, neglect of job assignments, deliberately delaying to complete a job assignment, visiting in other departments, stopping work before scheduled rest period, lunch hour or quitting time* | 
9 | Sleeping on duty* | 
10 | Smoking in unauthorized areas or premises of Company* | 
11 | Trespass into restricted areas within premises of the Company* | 
12 | Any act contrary and prejudicial to Company Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)* | 
13 | Failure to abide by safety rules and disregard for safety devices on equipment, refusal to conform to safety rules given by authorized personnel or any behavior of an unsafe manner incl. maintaining the cleanliness of work area* | 
14 | Condonation by immediate superior or supervisor i.e. failure to enforce discipline in conformance with set standards and SOPs* |

blocks.text: *Misconduct no. 8 – 14 may be considered as a major misconduct even if the employee committed it for the 1st time, where the impact of offence is huge (sizable) e.g. Company loss, possible high risk to the Company, tarnishing Company's image, Company has lost confidence and trust on the employee, etc.
b) Major Misconduct – 1st time misconduct

blocks.columns: No., Misconduct, Type of disciplinary action
blocks.rows:
1 | Insubordination i.e. failure to obey lawful or reasonable orders that are consistent with the terms and conditions of employment | 
2 | Quarrelling / Fighting with other employees / company's clients | 
3 | Consumption of Liquor on Company Premises / Intoxication / drug taking / drug selling | 
4 | Punching the time card for a friend | 
5 | Theft and embezzlement | 
6 | Sexual Harassment | 
7 | Possession / Dissemination / editing of pornographic materials in company premises | 
8 | Conflict of Interest | 
9 | Bribery / Corruption | 
10 | Breach of Fiduciary Duty i.e. failure to fulfill fiduciary duty to the Company or shareholders e.g. higher positions employee or board members acting on the best interest of himself rather than on the best interest of the Company and shareholders | 
11 | Cheating | 
12 | Misuse of Company Electronic Equipment | 
13 | Indecent behaviour – use of foul language, indecent attire, immoral act, etc. | 
14 | Assault / threaten others (verbally or physically) | 
15 | Damaging property belonging to the company, employees and clients | 
16 | Improper or illegal disclosure of Company's proprietary information | 
17 | Falsifying / alteration of any Company's document / record or information | 
18 | Loss of Company's property through negligence | 
19 | Making false reports | 
20 | Gambling | 
21 | Misappropriation i.e. abuse of position / power / authority in using Company's property and premises entrusted to him/her | 
22 | Sale of illegal drugs on Company premises | 
23 | Unauthorized possession of offensive weapons e.g. firearms or explosive | 
24 | Unauthorized possession of Company's property | 
25 | Remaining absent for more than two (2) consecutive working days [Section 15 (2) of employment ordinance] | 
26 | Misrepresentation – Deliberate concealment or misrepresentation of past history or other important matters | 
27 | Accepting other employment without the permission of the Company | 
28 | Accepting Money or Gifts – Taking advantage of one's position to accept money or property from others | 
29 | Other – any individual act or pattern of acts, conducts or expressions which are detrimental to the welfare of the Company, its employee or products. | 
30 | Conviction for Felony – a conviction or sentence for any crime under local and national statutes e.g. murder, rape, kidnapping, robbery, abetment of sizable offences, terrorism, etc. |

blocks.text: Note for item 30: All such cases shall be referred to the relevant authority.

blocks.label: I have read and understood the Major and Minor Misconduct listing above.

blocks.text: Acceptance of resignation

Dear {employee.name},

We refer to your letter of resignation dated {leaver.noticeDate}. The Company accepts your resignation, and your last working day with {company.name} will be {leaver.lastDay}.

As at your last working day you will have {leave.remaining} days of annual leave remaining. {leave.encashDays} days will be paid as leave encashment of {leave.encashAmount} (daily rate {leave.dailyRate}), together with your final salary on {pay.finalPayDate}.
Please hand over your work to your supervisor, {employee.supervisor}, return all Company property and complete the exit clearance by your last working day.
We thank you for your contributions to the Company and wish you every success in your future endeavours.

blocks.label: I acknowledge receipt of this letter.

blocks.text: Device Acceptance Acknowledgement (End User Acceptance Form)
Please complete this form on the day you receive your IT equipment from TechGBS personnel. / Sila lengkapkan borang ini pada hari anda menerima peralatan IT.
Your details / Maklumat anda
IT equipment received / Peralatan IT yang diterima
Acknowledgement & acceptance / Pengakuan & penerimaan

As a new user, I acknowledge that:
• I have received my assigned IT equipment and access credentials.
• I will keep my password confidential and will not share my account with others.
• I will comply with the organization's IT Security Policy, Acceptable Use Policy, and Data Protection Policy.
• I understand that company devices, email, and network activities may be monitored.
• I will immediately report any lost devices, suspected security incidents, or unauthorized access.
• I will use company resources only for authorized business purposes.
• I understand that software installation requires IT approval.
• I acknowledge that all company data remains the property of the organization.

blocks.text: New Joiner Onboarding Satisfaction Survey
Two-week follow-up survey. It takes about 10 minutes. Your answers help us improve onboarding for future new joiners at Chin Hin Group.
Respondent information
A. Recruiter & Pre-Onboarding
Rate each statement from 0 (strongly disagree / very poor) to 10 (strongly agree / excellent).
B. Day 1 Briefing & Facilitator
Rate each statement from 0 (strongly disagree / very poor) to 10 (strongly agree / excellent).
C. People Business Partner
Rate each statement from 0 (strongly disagree / very poor) to 10 (strongly agree / excellent).
D. Hiring Manager
Rate each statement from 0 (strongly disagree / very poor) to 10 (strongly agree / excellent).
E. Admin Readiness
Rate each statement from 0 (strongly disagree / very poor) to 10 (strongly agree / excellent).
F. Tech Readiness
Rate each statement from 0 (strongly disagree / very poor) to 10 (strongly agree / excellent).
G. Overall Experience
Rate each statement from 0 (strongly disagree / very poor) to 10 (strongly agree / excellent).
H. Employer Recommendation Score
Rate each statement from 0 (not at all likely) to 10 (extremely likely).

blocks.label: I confirm these are my own responses.

Q40. Overall, my onboarding experience at Chin Hin Group from the recruiter's first contact to today has been positive.

workflows.description: Switched off: joiners no longer have forms to complete before Day 1. Kept so you can reuse it.

Regards,
AI HR

workflows.name: Send the onboarding survey
workflows.description: On Day 7 (six days after the join date, which is Day 1), creates the Onboarding Satisfaction Survey and emails the joiner a link. They complete it in their employee view.

steps.subject: Reminder: onboarding survey

Thank you,
Human Resource Department

workflows.description: On Day 10, three days after the survey is sent, nudges the joiner if they have not submitted it.

workflows.name: Release the device acceptance form
workflows.description: On the join date, releases the Device Acceptance Acknowledgement form in the system. It appears in the joiner's employee view against its checklist task, with no email, and can be opened once that task opens.

workflows.name: Prepare the resignation acceptance letter
workflows.description: Generates the acceptance of resignation letter when the case is submitted and holds it for the HR signatory. It is not emailed from here: GBS People Ops review and send it from the checklist task "Review and send acceptance of resignation letter", with the line manager and PBP copied.

workflows.name: Remind a leaver before their last day
workflows.description: Reminds the leaver about handover, returns and the exit interview.

workflows.name: Send the exit form and survey
workflows.description: Ten working days before the last working day, creates the Exit Interview Form and the Offboarding Survey and emails the leaver a link to each. They complete both in their employee view.

workflows.name: Remind about the exit form and survey
workflows.description: Three working days after the exit form and survey go out, reminds the leaver. Skipped once both are submitted. The two document steps only create a form if it is missing, for a case submitted late.
